transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what made me decide to come in is that... after some really long days on site, or maybe after a late neighborhood meeting, I’ll come home and just eat way more than I ever meant to. 

I'll just go through whatever’s there—leftover takeout, cereal, chips, really anything—and I just keep eating until I’m uncomfortably full. It's been bothering me enough that I figured I should talk to someone about it.
After one of these episodes of eating a lot, do you ever try to get rid of the food or make up for it—like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual?

Yeah, I do. Um... a few times a month, after those nights where I eat everything, I’ve gone into the bathroom and made myself throw up. I just... I start to panic about undoing all the work I’ve put into looking put-together. So, yeah, that's what I do.
How often would you say these binge-eating and vomiting episodes happen—about how many times per week—and how long has this pattern been going on?

Well, looking back over the last few months... it probably averages out to about once a week. Some weeks it might happen twice, and then other weeks it won't happen at all. But yeah, that whole pattern has been going on for a few months now.
Would you say your opinion of yourself—how you feel about who you are as a person—is heavily influenced by your body weight or shape?

Yeah, I would definitely say so. Um... especially since I started wearing more fitted work clothes and being up front at meetings. I actually catch myself judging the whole day by whether my pants feel tight, or... or whether I think people can see my stomach. If I feel like I look heavy, it really just dictates how I feel about myself as a person.
Can you tell me your current height and weight, and whether your weight has changed significantly over the past few months?
I'm 5'6", and I weigh about 140 pounds. Um... my weight hasn't really changed much over the past few months. It pretty much stays right around there.
